quotes.title: Creatine loading protocol dosage
quotes.quote: 20g/day split into four 5g doses for 5–7 days, followed by a 3–5g/day maintenance dose

quotes.title: Creatine synthesis amino acids
quotes.quote: Creatine is synthesized from three amino acids — arginine, glycine, and methionine

quotes.title: Creatine storage location in body
quotes.quote: stored primarily in skeletal muscle, where it buffers the rapid regeneration of ATP during short, intense bursts of effort

quotes.title: Additional lean muscle mass from creatine in adults 50-70
quotes.quote: Roughly 1kg of additional lean muscle mass gained versus resistance training alone

quotes.title: Creatinine rises with creatine supplementation
quotes.quote: A common source of alarm is a rise in serum creatinine after starting creatine supplementation... Creatinine is simply the waste byproduct of creatine breakdown and is expected to rise with supplementation

quotes.title: Cystatin C not affected by creatine supplementation
quotes.quote: Cystatin C test... Rises with creatine supplementation? No

quotes.title: Cystatin C independence from muscle mass
quotes.quote: Cystatin C... Affected by muscle mass/diet? No

quotes.title: Creatine monohydrate is cheapest and most-studied form
quotes.quote: Creatine monohydrate — the cheapest and most-studied form, distinct from HCl or buffered variants
